title: 被 y marcadores aspectuales en datos de corpus

claimAssessments.claim: Xiao, McEnery, and Qian (2006) analyze British English and Mandarin Chinese using written and spoken corpora. For syntactic 被 passives, Table 9 reports 1,300 tokens: -le 213 (16.4%), -zhe 19 (1.5%), -guo 4 (0.3%), resultative verb complements 462 (35.5%), resultative de 48 (3.7%), negation 50 (3.8%), and bare forms 504 (38.8%). Their discussion states that aspect markers and resultative material follow the predicate, after 被; e.g. 被批評了, not *被了批評. These frequencies combine the corpora and are not an estimate for Taiwanese Mandarin alone.
